about.heading: Design with clarity.
paragraphs: I’m Gaurav Santosh Kirtane, a Graphic Designer & Creative Designer working under RK Creative Studio. I create professional visual content for brands, creators, businesses, and social platforms.

My work combines Adobe Photoshop and Canva with a strong focus on typography, layout design, visual hierarchy, and creative presentation. The goal is simple: make every design look polished, purposeful, and ready to use.
